text.en: Customer sentiment regarding the mobile groomer is sharply divided between enthusiastic praise and severe complaints. Satisfied clients describe Callie as an amazing and talented professional who creates enjoyable grooming sessions. Conversely, negative reviews report unprofessional interpersonal interactions and erratic driving behaviour.

Clients who were pleased with the service report high satisfaction with the physical grooming outcomes. Reviewers highlight neat haircuts, clean coats, and thorough styling tailored to individual dog breeds. Multiple pet parents mention recommending her work to friends and family based on the quality of the finished haircuts.

Dog owners note that pets appear comfortable and happy during their grooming appointments in the mobile van. Positive reviewers describe dogs enjoying the experience, while even critical commentators acknowledge that the groomer possesses natural talent and affinity when working directly with animals.

q.en: Does Cal's K9 Clips provide mobile grooming at the customer's home?

a.en: Yes, the service operates a fully equipped mobile grooming van that travels directly to clients' locations.

q.en: Can owners watch their dog being groomed?

a.en: One reviewer noted that the groomer shared a live stream of the grooming session on social media during the appointment.

q.en: Are services suitable for small and medium dog breeds?

a.en: Yes, clients report haircuts and washes performed for various family pet breeds at their residence.

q.en: What do customer reviews say about the groomer's customer service?

a.en: Reviews are split; several owners praise her friendly style, while others cite unprofessional conduct and communication disputes.
